title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
lede: Supertake lets users describe a market view in plain language, then has agents refine it with them into a stock portfolio held at Coinbase or Robinhood. It raised a $20 million seed round.

points: Adjacent led the round, with Coinbase Ventures, Union Square Ventures and angels including Nat Friedman and Guillermo Rauch; it follows a $2 million pre-seed.
Anchor co-founder Michael Mignano incubated it at USV; former Coinbase AI leads Lincoln Murr (CEO) and John Peterson (CTO) run it.
Frontier models sit behind proprietary software that directs and limits what the agents may do.
Guardrails include no deposits or withdrawals without consent, drift limits, allow and deny lists, trade size caps, anomaly monitoring and no credential access.
A public leaderboard lets others invest alongside a take; shorts, derivatives and prediction markets may follow. Access is waitlisted in beta.

sections.text: The guardrail list is a concrete pattern for agents that move money: scoped permissions, hard limits, live monitoring, and brokerage credentials kept out of the model's reach.
